summary: Battle moments, a kill and loss tally, idle squads and under-fire alerts, a compact fire mission list, readable squad cards and unique names.
stage: game capture, 1920x1080 player view, off-screen window, --perf=0: --host --team=0 --seed=4 --select-first --timescale=6 --shot-at=25 --shot-every=215 --shots=3 (before on f302f20e, after on this branch); --scenario=roster --play --seed=1 --focus=-84,24 --zoom=60 --shot-at=8 --shot-every=3 (moments)
rationale: A HUD layout change: matched before/after frames of the same battle at three times show the fire list, idle readout, tally and squad card; a busy tank fight shows moments as they land. A new matched gameplay recording demonstrates repeat ordering, updated grid/count/jump hint and reduced-motion entry; older stills remain historical evidence.

repeat_capture.controls: Same capture fixture copied into both revisions. Attack seed 3, map 1024 m, day, low preset, camera (0,0,-5), distance 90. Scripted real vehicle damage at 2.0/3.4/4.8 s; recording disabled for isolated fixture; input disabled. FL_REDUCED=0 for matched arms and 1 for reduced-motion arm.
repeat_capture.engine: Official Godot 4.7.2 ed1daf0bf, Linux Xvfb, Compatibility, Mesa llvmpipe; actual rendered movie frames, not runtime performance evidence.
repeat_capture.command: DISPLAY=:99 FL_REDUCED=0 GODOT --path . --rendering-method gl_compatibility --audio-driver Dummy --resolution 960x600 --fixed-fps 30 --write-movie CAPTURE.avi tests/fixtures/battle-feedback-clips.tscn (reduced: FL_REDUCED=1 and --quit-after 100)
repeat_capture.frames: Before and after: 271 frames each at fixed 30 Hz; reduced: 100 frames. Event logs report drawn counts 59/102/144; at the repeat before keeps TECHNICAL first, after moves HUMVEE first with position (22,0,-5) and count 2.
repeat_capture.edit: Native movie 1600x900; center crop 960x600 at (320,0), no time scaling. Before 1.5-7.0 s, after 1.5-7.0 s, reduced 1.5-3.3 s; bottom labels; silent VP9 WebM 12.8 s. Fade verified in consecutive frames around first event; reduced fully opaque immediately.
repeat_capture.limits: Controlled fixture encounter, not public multiplayer. Shows notice and jump-hint updates, not a camera jump. Software capture supports appearance/behavior only. Existing asset UID and exit ObjectDB warnings remain; no script errors in accepted captures.
